rules.sentence: Gram staining is often the initial diagnostic test for evaluating infections due to its ability to quickly identify the presence and type of bacteria.
This rapid preliminary result is especially useful in managing conditions such as pneumonia, urinary tract infections, and meningitis.[16]

Although Gram staining offers quick insights, it is less specific compared to advanced molecular techniques and genetic sequencing, which can precisely identify bacterial species and resistance patterns, enhancing diagnostic accuracy and treatment efficacy.[17]
